# Helper classes to simulate a span and its instrumentation scope
class FakeScope:
    def __init__(self, attrs: dict):
        self.attributes = attrs
        self.name = "fake-scope"

class FakeSpan:
    def __init__(self, public_key: str):
        self.name = "test-span"
        self.instrumentation_scope = FakeScope({"public_key": public_key})

class RecordingExporter(SpanExporter):
    def __init__(self):
        self.exported: List[object] = []

    def export(self, spans):
        self.exported.extend(spans)
        return SpanExportResult.SUCCESS

    def shutdown(self):
        pass

def test_allow_cross_project_flag_prevents_dropping_spans(monkeypatch):
    # Force the processor to think every span is a Langfuse span
    monkeypatch.setattr(span_processor_module, "is_langfuse_span", lambda span: True)

    proc_a = LangfuseSpanProcessor(

        secret_key="sk-main",
        base_url="http://localhost",
        span_exporter=exporter_a,
        should_export_span=lambda span: True,
    )
    proc_a.on_end(foreign_span)
    assert exporter_a.exported == []  # span was filtered out
    proc_a.shutdown()

    # Processor with allow_cross_project=True should forward the span

    proc_b = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk-main",
        secret_key="sk-main",
        base_url="http://localhost",
        span_exporter=exporter_b,
        should_export_span=lambda span: True,
        allow_cross_project=True,
    )
    proc_b.on_end(foreign_span)
    assert exporter_b.exported == [foreign_span]  # span passed through
    proc_b.shutdown()"
}
